providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): USGS has no controlled global mosaic for Miranda, only a nomenclature map and a Voyager 2 control-point network (imagery covers roughly its southern hemisphere only, from the single 1986 flyby). Procedural texture: large distinct-terrain patches approximate its real coronae (Inverness/Arden/Elsinore chevron terrains) — the generator has no linear-groove primitive, so the actual V-shaped ridges are not modeled, only their presence as a distinct terrain type.
